title: refactor(plugin-list,plugin-dashboard,app-shell): one authority each for ViewSwitcherProps, RecordDetailDrawerProps and PageHeaderComponentProps (objectui#6349, batch 8)
body:
Refs #6349 (batch 8)

Clause-②: yes

Batch 8 of the one-authority burn-down, on claim `6090897330` (seat `domain:ui#3`, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`). Three component-props rows of `KNOWN_COLLISIONS` converge, so the ledger goes from 16 rows to 13. None of the three has an `@object-ui/types` side. Each row was two components behind one props name, so in each row the side with the narrower meaning takes a specific name. Types, comments and changeset prose only: no runtime behaviour changes, and no emitted JavaScript changes.

This PR has no closing keyword. The card stays open for later batches.

**This is a resumed run.** A dev run on this claim was killed by a container restart after it pushed `cc75cab8d` and before it opened a PR or reported. This run reviewed that commit as its own draft against the brief and the claim, kept all of it, and added `5dd334645`, which corrects one wrong statement the first commit made in three places (see "What the second commit corrects").

## What each row was (measured on base `20c6d351`)

The member lists come from one TypeScript program over each package's BUILT root entry (`exports["."].types`), with dist rebuilt for the base tree.

**`ViewSwitcherProps`: two switchers, so plugin-list's side is renamed.**

| site | members | meaning | built entry |
|---|---|---|---|
| `packages/plugin-view/src/ViewSwitcher.tsx` | `schema` (a `ViewSwitcherSchema`), `className?`, `onViewChange?`, `onCreateView?`, `onViewAction?`, `createViewLabel?`, and a string index signature. Views are typed on `@object-ui/types`' `ViewType` | the props of the registered `view-switcher` renderer | exported at the plugin-view root |
| `packages/plugin-list/src/ViewSwitcher.tsx` | `currentView`, `availableViews?`, `onViewChange`, `className?`, `animated?`. Views are typed on `@object-ui/core`'s `ListViewVisualization` | the props of the list view's own visualization switcher (`ViewSwitcher` and `ViewSwitcherDropdown`) | exported at the plugin-list root. 0 readers through it in the repo, and 0 hits in `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0 |

The two share `className` and `onViewChange`, and `onViewChange` differs in both optionality and parameter type. Neither package depends on the other, so batch 3's rule rules out a re-point in either direction. plugin-list's switcher is the narrower meaning. Its declaration becomes `ListViewSwitcherProps`, and the plugin-list root publishes that name in place of `ViewSwitcherProps`. This is the shape batch 7's amendment `6089430007` accepted for `GroupAggregationConfig`. The members are unchanged, and the `ViewSwitcher` and `ViewSwitcherDropdown` components keep their names.

**`RecordDetailDrawerProps`: two drawers, so plugin-dashboard's side is renamed.**

| site | members | meaning | built entry |
|---|---|---|---|
| `packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordDetailDrawer.tsx` | `open`, `onClose`, `title`, `record`, `objectName`, `recordId`, `dataSource?`, `objectSchema?`, `width?`, `columns?`, `systemFields?`, `onFieldSave?`, `onDelete?`, `resizable?`, `fullPageHref?` | the published, editable record drawer (save, delete, resize) | exported at the plugin-detail root |
| `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/RecordDetailDrawer.tsx` | `record` (may be `null`), `objectName?`, `objectSchema?`, `fields?`, `title?`, `target?` (`drawer` or `dialog`), `onClose`, `objectTypesPending?` | the read-only drill drawer of the dashboard's table widget | not exported. A program rooted at the plugin-dashboard entry loads 21 of the package's own declaration files, and `RecordDetailDrawer.d.ts` is not one of them |

Five member names are shared, and four of those differ in optionality or type. Neither package depends on the other. The dashboard's declaration becomes `DashboardRecordDetailDrawerProps`. No entry reached it, so no published name moves.

**`PageHeaderComponentProps`: two headers, so app-shell's side is renamed.**

| site | members | meaning | built entry |
|---|---|---|---|
| `packages/layout/src/PageHeader.tsx` | `title: string` and `subtitle?: string` (both resolve record tokens), `icon?` (a name or a node), `action?`, `showBack?`, `actions?` (action definitions handed to `record:quick_actions`), `schema?`, and every `div` attribute | the props of layout's published `PageHeader` component | exported at the layout root |
| `packages/app-shell/src/layout/PageHeader.tsx` | `title`, `subtitle?`, `icon?` and `actions?` as rendered nodes, `accentColor?`, `sticky?`, `className?`, `data-testid?` | the console's own title row, used by `ObjectView` and `ObjectDataPage` | not exported by name. The entry loads the file through `layout/index`, and the `exports` map has no subpath that reaches it |

app-shell depends on layout, so here a re-point is dependency-legal. This run measured it on base: with app-shell's name re-exported from `@object-ui/layout` (its own declaration set aside), app-shell's `tsc --noEmit` exits 2 with 8 errors. Three are TS2339 (`accentColor`, `sticky` and `data-testid` are not layout members), one is TS2322 inside the header, and four are in the two console callers (a rendered element is not a `string` title, and a rendered element is not an `unknown[]` of actions). The unmutated control exits 0 with 0 errors. So this is two meanings, not drift. The console's declaration becomes `ConsolePageHeaderProps`, and layout is the one authority for the name. Neither header is the `page:header` renderer: `@object-ui/components` registers that node type.

## Published surface, base vs head

One TypeScript program per tree over the six packages' built root entries. Dist was rebuilt for each tree, and every head marker was read in dist before measuring.

- **Exported name sets:**
  - plugin-view 39 = 39; plugin-detail 105 = 105; plugin-dashboard 25 = 25; layout 37 = 37; app-shell 258 = 258;
  - plugin-list 19 = 19: `ViewSwitcherProps` out, `ListViewSwitcherProps` in, with identical members.
- **Unchanged shapes:** plugin-view's `ViewSwitcherProps`, plugin-detail's `RecordDetailDrawerProps` and layout's `PageHeaderComponentProps`. Each member list is identical on base and head.
- **Files each entry loads:** the set of the package's own declaration files is identical on base and head in all six packages.
- **An external consumer**, probed as a virtual file that resolves the packages through `node_modules`:
  - at head, `import type { ViewSwitcherProps } from '@object-ui/plugin-list'` fails loudly with TS2724, which names the replacement: "Did you mean 'ListViewSwitcherProps'?". `ListViewSwitcherProps` compiles with 0 diagnostics;
  - on base, the old spelling reads 0 diagnostics and the new one reads TS2724, so the probe is lit;
  - the old and new dashboard names from `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`, and the old and new console names from `@object-ui/app-shell`, read TS2305 on BOTH trees. Neither name was ever importable from those entries;
  - the control leg imports `ViewSwitcherProps` from plugin-view, `RecordDetailDrawerProps` from plugin-detail, `PageHeaderComponentProps` from layout, and the `ViewSwitcher` and `ViewSwitcherDropdown` components from plugin-list. It reads 0 diagnostics on base and on head.
- **Emitted output:** base and head dist differ only in declaration files:
  - plugin-list: `ViewSwitcher` and `index` (with their maps);
  - plugin-dashboard: `RecordDetailDrawer` (with its map);
  - app-shell: `layout/PageHeader` and `layout/index`;
  - layout: `PageHeader` (JSDoc only).

  No `.js` or `.css` file differs in any of the six packages, and plugin-view and plugin-detail dist are byte-identical. So no first-load bytes move.

## Changesets

| file | grade | why |
|---|---|---|
| `6349-batch8-plugin-list.md` | `minor` | A published name leaves the root (`ViewSwitcherProps`) and its replacement arrives (`ListViewSwitcherProps`). Breaking-change note with the migration and the TS2724 hint. |
| `6349-batch8-plugin-dashboard.md` | `patch` | A renamed declaration that no entry reaches. Nothing published moves. |
| `6349-batch8-app-shell.md` | `patch` | The same. |
| `6349-batch8-layout.md` | `patch` | JSDoc only on the published `PageHeaderComponentProps`: it no longer says app-shell shares the name. |

plugin-view and plugin-detail are not touched, so they get no changeset. The grades follow the claim's per-package criterion. ⛔ No `major`.

**Batch 7's pending changeset is edited too.** `.changeset/6349-batch7-plugin-list.md` is not released yet. It said "`ViewSwitcherProps` keeps its members, and `ViewSwitcherProps['currentView']` names the same union". This PR makes that sentence false in the same release, so it now names `ListViewSwitcherProps` and says the props were renamed in batch 8. Its declaration (`@object-ui/plugin-list: minor`) is unchanged. `check-changeset-overwrite` reports the touch as report-only, with the declaration unchanged on both sides.

## What the second commit corrects

`cc75cab8d` called layout's `PageHeader` "the renderer of the authored `page:header` node" in three places: the `ConsolePageHeaderProps` JSDoc, the app-shell changeset and the ledger comment that replaces the `PageHeaderComponentProps` row. That is not so. `@object-ui/components` registers `page:header`, and layout's own `registerLayout` records that its header's registration (under the kebab `page-header` key) was retired. `5dd334645` describes layout's header by its props instead, and says which package renders `page:header`. It changes comments and changeset prose only.

## Rider

From batch 7's ACCEPT: the plugin-list switcher's icon-map comment said "the same glyph for the same `ViewType`". Inside plugin-list that bare name now means `@object-ui/types`' wider vocabulary, so the comment now says "the same glyph for the same visualization".

## Gates

Heavy runs went through `os-verify-lock`. Everything below is at head `5dd334645` unless it says `cc75cab8d`. The second commit changed only the app-shell header JSDoc, one changeset body and comment lines in the gate file, so the runs at `cc75cab8d` cover the same plugin-list, plugin-dashboard and layout sources as head.

- **The gate**, `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`: exit 0, `Tests 11 passed (11)`. The ledger has 13 rows.
- **Suites:**
  - at `cc75cab8d`: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over `packages/plugin-list/`, `packages/layout/`, `packages/app-shell/src/layout/`, app-shell's `spec-symbol-parity.test.ts` and 18 test files elsewhere that read a touched file's text or path: exit 0, `Test Files 239 passed (239)`, `Tests 2735 passed (2735)`;
  - at `cc75cab8d`: `packages/plugin-dashboard/`: exit 0, `Test Files 174 passed (174)`, `Tests 1725 passed, 6 skipped (1731)`. The 6 skips are the two `describe.runIf(DRIVEN)` time-zone suites in the date-only-zone filter-bar test;
  - at head: `packages/app-shell/src/layout/`, the parity test, `packages/layout/src/__tests__/` and the 18 readers again: exit 0, `Test Files 114 passed (114)`, `Tests 1351 passed (1351)`.
- **Type-checks**, with dist rebuilt and the script names echoed:
  - at `cc75cab8d`: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/PKG type-check` for plugin-list, plugin-view, plugin-dashboard, plugin-detail and layout, chained: exit 0, 0 `error TS` lines;
  - at head: app-shell's `type-check` and `pnpm type-check:scripts`, chained: exit 0, 0 `error TS` lines;
  - the touched tests are in scope: app-shell's `tsconfig.test.json` lists both touched app-shell tests, layout's lists its touched test, and `tsconfig.scripts.json` lists the gate.
- `check:doc-snippets`: 785 of 785 blocks judged, 0 failed, after its own scoped build. `check:readme-exports`: OK, 582 of 582 self-imports real.
- Each exit 0: `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:icon-record-names` (it reads the plugin-list switcher's icon map), `check:spec-symbols`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, and `check-changeset-presence` (9 source files of 4 released packages, 4 changesets).
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the 10 touched TS files: 0 errors. The 10 warnings sit on unchanged lines in layout's `PageHeader.tsx`, the dashboard drawer and the plugin-list barrel, and those three files carry the same counts at base (4, 3 and 3).
- The governed-queue guard reads NOT GOVERNED over the 15 paths.
- `git merge-tree` against `main` `20c6d351` is clean. `main` has not moved since the base.

Not run locally:
- **The full app-shell suite.** CI runs it.
- **The type-checks of the console and the other dependants.** No file outside the six packages names any of the renamed types, and the only published move is plugin-list's, which has 0 readers in the repo.
- **The i18n gates.** No locale pack changed.

## Reverse verification

Every leg went through `ablation-replace` in wrap mode, with predictions written before any leg ran. The gate is a source scan, so no dist leg applies. Each leg landed on disk (anchor count 1 to 0, blob changed) and was restored with blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`, which the tool checked and the driver checked again. All legs below were re-run at head `5dd334645` with the same results.

| leg | mutation | result (as predicted) |
|---|---|---|
| S1 | the `ViewSwitcherProps` row put back | `Tests 1 failed, 10 passed`; `no longer collides at:` lists both `ViewSwitcher.tsx` files |
| S2 | the `RecordDetailDrawerProps` row put back | same verdict; lists the plugin-dashboard and plugin-detail `RecordDetailDrawer.tsx` |
| S3 | the `PageHeaderComponentProps` row put back | same verdict; lists app-shell's and layout's `PageHeader.tsx` |
| F1 | the plugin-list barrel re-exports `ListViewSwitcherProps as ViewSwitcherProps` (the tempting back-compat shim) | `ViewSwitcherProps — a NEW colliding name`: the plugin-list barrel (aliasing re-export) and plugin-view's `ViewSwitcher.tsx` (type declaration) |
| F2 | the dashboard declaration renamed back | `RecordDetailDrawerProps — a NEW colliding name`: both `RecordDetailDrawer.tsx` (interface declaration each) |
| F3 | the console declaration renamed back | `PageHeaderComponentProps — a NEW colliding name`: both `PageHeader.tsx` (interface declaration each) |
| control | unmutated, before and after the legs | `Tests 11 passed (11)` |

The failing test in every leg is "declares no name twice outside the named, shrinking baseline". The first attempt at S1 to S3 was a no-op: each replacement kept its neighbouring ledger row verbatim, so it contained its own anchor. `ablation-replace` saw the anchor count stay at 1, refused the write and restored the file without running the gate. Those three readings were voided, the anchors were moved onto each row's own comment line, and the legs above are the second attempt.

## Acceptance notes

- **One published-name move.** `ListViewSwitcherProps` is new on the plugin-list root, replacing `ViewSwitcherProps`. It is the rename target that the dispatch's rule implies for a published site ("a rename of a published site publishes the specific name at the same entry"), so this PR does not treat it as an extra export.
- **JSDoc on each renamed site** says why the general name is not used, so the next author does not restore it.
- **Stale pointers, not touched (outside the claim's file surface).** Four plugin comments and their four tripwire tests cite as precedent the rename of `PageHeaderProps` to `PageHeaderComponentProps` "(app-shell)": `ObjectCalendar.tsx`, `ObjectForm.tsx`, `ObjectGrid.tsx`, `ObjectKanban.tsx`, and the `spec-symbol-4650.test.ts` beside each. The precedent stays true as history (app-shell made that rename in objectui#3169, and layout carries the name today), but the "(app-shell)" pointer now lands on `ConsolePageHeaderProps`, whose JSDoc records the rename. The four source comments ship in each package's declaration JSDoc. Changing them here would add four packages and four changesets for prose alone, so they are left for the seat to carry as a rider if it wants one.
- **Pre-existing, not changed.** app-shell's subtitle test header and layout's `PageHeaderComponentProps` JSDoc still describe layout's header as the rendered layer of the `page:header` node, although objectui#10859 retired its registration. That text predates this PR and this PR does not make it falser. It is noted here only.
